Create a density plot

Source: R/density_plot.R
density_plot.Rd

Draws a smooth estimate of the distribution of a numeric variable, one curve per group, overlapping or stacked. The densities are computed in R with stats::density(), so they match plot(density(x)) and ggplot2::geom_density().

Usage

density_plot(
  data,
  x,
  group = NULL,
  bandwidth = "nrd0",
  adjust = 1,
  position = c("identity", "stack", "fill"),
  stat = c("none", "mean", "median"),
  rug = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  fill_opacity = 0.35,
  line_width = 2,
  value_format = ",.2~f",
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  axis_title_font_size = 12,
  x_font_size = 11,
  y_font_size = 11,
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_font_size = 11,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  grid_col = "#ececec",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

x

The name of the numeric column.

group

Optional. The name of a column that splits the data into curves. Factor levels give the order.

bandwidth

Optional. The smoothing bandwidth, a number or the name of a rule understood by stats::density() ("nrd0", "nrd", "ucv", "bcv", "SJ"). Defaults to "nrd0".

adjust

A multiplier of the bandwidth: values above 1 give smoother curves. Defaults to 1.

position

"identity" (the default) draws the curves on top of each other, "stack" stacks them (each curve weighted by the size of its group) and "fill" shows the share of each group at every value.

stat

Optional reference lines per curve: "none" (the default), "mean" or "median".

rug

Logical. Draw the observations as small ticks along the axis. Defaults to TRUE when there are at most 1000 of them.

colors

Optional. Colours of the curves: one per group, or a named vector matched to the groups.

fill_opacity

The opacity of the areas. Defaults to 0.35.

line_width

The width of the curves. Defaults to 2.

value_format

A d3 format for the x values in the tooltip. Defaults to ",.2~f".

x_title, y_title

Optional. The titles of the axes. The x axis is titled with x by default.

axis_title_font_size

The font size of the axis titles. Defaults to 12.

x_font_size, y_font_size

The font sizes of the tick labels. Default to 11.

legend

Logical. Show a legend when there are groups. Defaults to TRUE.

legend_font_size

The font size of the legend. Defaults to 11.

hover

Logical. Show the guide and the tooltip. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Let the curves rise when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text and the axes. Defaults to "#333333".

grid_col

The colour of the grid lines; NULL for none. Defaults to "#ececec".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Move the mouse over the chart: a vertical guide follows it and the tooltip gives the density of every group at that value. Click a group in the legend to hide or show it. The curves rise from the axis when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking the chart sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with the x value and the densities.

Examples

density_plot(faithful, x = "eruptions", title = "Old Faithful eruptions",
             x_title = "Duration (minutes)")



density_plot(iris, x = "Petal.Length", group = "Species", stat = "median")



density_plot(
  ggplot2::diamonds,
  x = "price",
  group = "cut",
  position = "fill",
  rug = FALSE,
  title = "Share of each cut along the price range"
)
